fields.description: A fragment page, e.g. under /modals/. Opens in a dialog.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Title, description, tags, date, reading time, author, story link, download and share come from the page properties.

fields.name: secondaryCtaText
fields.label: Second CTA Title
fields.description: Shown after the page's story link.

fields.name: authorName
fields.label: Author Name
fields.description: Shown above the page's Designation & Location.

fields.name: collectionLabel
fields.label: Collection Label
fields.description: Shown after the tags, e.g. Collection.

fields.name: listenLink
fields.label: Listen Link
fields.description: Audio version of the page (shows a headphones icon).

fields.name: author
fields.label: Quote Author
fields.description: Name on the first line, then designation and organisation.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alt Text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: maxCards
fields.label: Maximum Cards
fields.description: Display between 1 and 4 cards.

validation.customErrorMsg: Maximum Cards must be between 1 and 4.

fields.name: showTags
fields.label: Show Tags
fields.description: Display each card's tags above its description (Title Right variation only).

fields.name: viewAllLabel
fields.label: View All Title
fields.description: Text of the header "View all" link.

fields.name: viewAllLink
fields.label: View All Link
fields.description: Destination URL for the header "View all" link. The link is shown only when set.

fields.name: motion
fields.label: Motion Type
fields.description: Animates the cards as they scroll into view (not in table view, or when reduced motion is preferred).

fields.name: listHeading
fields.label: List Title
fields.description: Heading of the list. Leave blank to use the Table List Header item heading.

fields.name: exploreLink
fields.label: Explore All Link
fields.description: Legacy header link. The parent View All settings take precedence when configured.

fields.name: number
fields.label: Number
fields.description: Optional. Leave blank to number cards automatically.

fields.description: Destination page path for the card.

fields.name: tag1

fields.name: tag2
fields.label: Tag 2
fields.description: Optional second tag displayed above the description.

fields.name: shortDescription
fields.label: Short Description
fields.description: Shown after the links.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image alt text
fields.description: Leave empty if the image is decorative.

fields.name: titleHidden
fields.label: Hide Title
fields.description: The title stays available to screen readers.

fields.description: On: a list of links. Off: a primary and a secondary button.
